settings.about:
ByVasoVasiko is the studio of Vaso Vasiko and Andrei Aivazian. Vaso, born Vasil Kurakhchishvili in Georgia in 1980, has tattooed since 2000, mainly in Turkey, from a room on İstiklal Avenue in Istanbul, with frequent guest spots in Europe. Andrei is based in Tbilisi, associated with Black Kiss Tattoo and his own studio, with more than a decade of conventions, guest spots, and teaching.

Appointments for the two of them go through the studio form. Visiting artists keep their own pages and talk to clients on this site. That chat does not replace a booking with Vaso or Andrei.

artists.name: Vaso Vasiko
artists.blurb: Vasil Kurakhchishvili was born in Georgia in 1980 and has tattooed professionally since 2000. The career was built mainly in Turkey: Japanese irezumi and neo-traditional work from a studio on İstiklal Avenue in Istanbul, and frequent guest spots at studios in Europe.
artists.history:
Vasil Kurakhchishvili was born in Georgia in 1980. He has tattooed professionally since 2000, and that career was built mainly in Turkey. The studio is on İstiklal Avenue in Istanbul. He also takes frequent guest spots at studios in Europe.

The work he is known for is Japanese irezumi and neo-traditional, and he also works black and grey, geometric, realism, and old and new school. The large custom pieces are sleeves, back pieces, and leg suits: dragons, hannya, samurai, snakes, peonies, and koi. The drawing is made to follow the body. Contrast is heavy, the lines are bold, the backgrounds move, and the color is chosen so it ages well.

From the early 2000s he brought large-scale custom Japanese and neo-traditional work into a Turkish scene that was mostly small tribal and flash. He pushed single-use needles, better pigments, and European hygiene practice. The studio on İstiklal is a high-profile room. Collaborations with European studios, and the standard of the work, made him a reference point for younger artists.

Sponsors named for this practice: Cheyenne Tattoo Equipment, Radiant Tattoo Ink, and Aloe Tattoo.

The plates on this page are studio studies of those motifs. They are not photographs of healed tattoos.

artists.name: Andrei Aivazian
artists.blurb: Andrei Aivazian is a veteran tattoo artist based in Tbilisi, Georgia, associated with Black Kiss Tattoo and his own studio. Realism, portraiture, and black and grey lead more than a decade of conventions, guest spots, and teaching.
artists.history:
Andrei Aivazian is a veteran tattoo artist based in Tbilisi, Georgia. He is associated with Black Kiss Tattoo and with his own studio. More than a decade of conventions, guest spots, and teaching sits behind the work.

Realism, portraiture, and black and grey are the core. Japanese and Oriental work, and color, sit beside them. He is known for hyper-real portraits, for texture, for deep contrast, and for smooth gradients.

He trained artists in Tbilisi, including Tatia Godibadze, on machine work, needle choice, and professional ethics. His studios pushed the local scene toward custom portfolios and international hygiene standards. Guest spots, and the standard of the work, are what put Tbilisi in front of clients outside Georgia.

Sponsors named for this practice: Kwadron, World Famous Tattoo Ink, and Dragon Tattoo Supply.

No portrait photograph of Andrei is on file for this page. The mark above is a placeholder, not a picture of him.

events.title: Marmaris Tattoo Festival
events.description: The Marmaris Tattoo Festival — also called the Marmari Tattoo Festival in conversation, and listed on the existing partners page as Marmaris Tattoo Convention — is an international gathering in Marmaris, Turkey. The last publicly announced edition ran 3–5 October 2025 at Green Nature Diamond Hotel, with artists from many countries, competitions, and walk-up work. A 2026 date was not on the studio news pages. Update this entry when the next edition is confirmed.
